name: Javier Blas
zh_summary: @JavierBlas：10月16日Copernicus Sentinel 1雷達影像顯示，在胡塞武裝向沙特延布及Al Muajjiz油港一帶發動彈道攻擊（沙特稱已攔截）後，多艘油輪仍在裝貨。
en_summary: @JavierBlas: Copernicus Sentinel 1 radar imagery of Saudi oil ports Yanbu and Al Muajjiz on Oct 16, after a Houthi ballistic attack on the area (intercepted, per the Saudis), shows multiple tankers still loading.
text: The Saudi oil ports of Yanbu and Al Muajjiz, in SAR imagery from @CopernicusEU Sentinel 1 on Oct 16 at 3.29pm GMT, that's it, **after** the Houthi ballistic attack against that area (intercepted, per the Saudis). The SAR imagery shows multiple tankers still loading.

name: Javier Blas
zh_summary: @JavierBlas：伊朗效仿索馬里海盜手法；@UK_MTO報告一艘在波斯灣內、遠離荷姆茲海峽的油輪遭小艇以火箭推進榴彈襲擊。
en_summary: @JavierBlas: Iran is following the Somali pirates playbook; @UK_MTO reports a tanker inside the Persian Gulf, far from Hormuz, was attacked by a small boat firing an RPG.
text:
Iran follows the Somali pirates playbook:  

@UK_MTO reports that an oil tanker was attacked inside the Persian Gulf, far away the Strait of Hormuz: a small boat approached it and then someone fired a RPG (rocket-propelled grenade) against the vessel.

name: Elon Musk
zh_summary: 原版Roadster。引述2008年Elon向Jay Leno展示首輛量產Tesla Roadster（6831顆鋰離子電池）及Leno試駕後對即時扭力與安靜的正面評價。
en_summary: OG Roadster. Quotes 2008 video of Elon showing Jay Leno the first production Tesla Roadster with 6,831 lithium-ion cells and Leno's positive test drive comments on instant torque and quietness.

name: Palmer Luckey
zh_summary: @PalmerLuckey：美國製造並非不可能；iPhone要價37,000美元或筆電100,000美元的說法是心理戰，多數來自想把生產留在中國的美國企業。
en_summary: @PalmerLuckey: American made products are not impossible; stories of $37,000 iPhones or $100,000 laptops are psy-ops, mostly from US corporations that want to keep manufacturing in China.
text: American-made products are not impossible.  Stories about iPhones costing $37,000 or laptops costing $100,000 are psy-ops, sometimes pushed by foreign adversaries but more commonly by American corporations that want anything but an upset to the status quo.
